Landing Page

03. AGENT DIRECTORY PAGE (AI Agent Profiles & Prompt Strategies)

Route: /directory (AgentDirectoryPage.tsx)

What it is:

A deep-dive inspection directory detailing the "brains", prompt instructions, system strategies, and individual cryptographic receipts for every registered AI agent.

Key Functionality & Elements to Point Out:

1. Agent Cards:

- Strategy Type Badge: Indicates strategy (GROQ_LLAMA vs DETERMINISTIC).

- Avatar & Persona: Visual indicators for agent role (e.g. AlphaTrader: High-Frequency Speculator, BetaBuyer: Conservative Consumer, OracleNode: Data Provider, Arbitrageur: Spread Arbitrageur).

- Programmatic Ethers Wallet: Displayed short-address (0x0ecb...71a73).

- Live Economic Stats: Real-time $CRED balance and Reputation Score (PTS).

2. Interactive Agent Diagnostic Drawer (Click Modal):

- Full Wallet Address: Complete 42-character Ethereum-compatible wallet address.

- Strategy & Prompt Specification: The exact system prompt given to Groq LLaMA 3 70B (e.g., "System Strategy: High-Frequency Speculative Order Book Trader. Evaluates bids/asks and places aggressive orders around asset price...").

- Live Agent Decision Log: The natural language output from the LLM explaining why the agent placed its last trade or service call.

- Escrow & Service Receipts: Detailed ledger of all past microservice contracts bought or sold by this specific agent (Service Type, Price in CRED, Status: Escrowed/Delivered).

What to Click / Do:

1. Navigate to Agent Directory from the main menu or header.
2. Click on AlphaTrader or OracleNode card to open the Agent Diagnostics Drawer.
3. Point out the Prompt Specification block and the Escrow & Service Receipts table.

What to Say to the Judge:
🗣️ WHAT TO SAY TO THE JUDGE:
Now let's look at Page 03: The Agent Directory. In many AI demos, agent decision-making is a black box. In AgentX, we provide complete transparency. If I click on AlphaTrader, an Agent Diagnostics drawer slides up. Here, judges can inspect the exact system prompt governing this agent's trading strategy, its full programmatic wallet address, and its latest LLM decision reasoning generated via Groq. Furthermore, at the bottom, we see the agent's itemized Escrow & Service Receipts—giving an auditable history of every service this specific agent bought or fulfilled.

04. ON-CHAIN EXPLORER PAGE (Polygon Amoy Verified Ledger)

Route: /explorer (ExplorerPage.tsx)

What it is:

The public verification engine and cryptographic transaction ledger connecting every simulation action to the Polygon Amoy testnet.

Key Functionality & Elements to Point Out:

1. Interactive Filter Bar:

- All Logs: View every system event.

- Trades: Filter by peer-to-peer token orders matched on the order book.

- Escrow Locks: Filter by openEscrow() calls on TradeEscrow.sol.

- Releases: Filter by release() calls when service delivery is verified.

2. Cryptographic Transaction Table:

- Timestamp: Execution time formatted down to the second.

- Type Tag: Colored badges distinguishing TRADE, SERVICE_CALL, and ESCROW_RELEASE.

- Description: Human-readable narrative of the transaction (e.g., "AlphaTrader bought 5.0 CRED tokens @ $10.00 from Arbitrageur").

- Value ($CRED): Exact amount transferred.

- Transaction Hash: 66-character hexadecimal tx hash with a 1-click Copy Hash clipboard button.

- Polygonscan Verification Button: External link button (Polygonscan ↗) leading directly to the Polygon Amoy block explorer (https://amoy.polygonscan.com/tx/0x...).

What to Click / Do:

1. Navigate to On-Chain Explorer.
2. Click the filter button "Escrow Locks" to isolate smart contract escrow transactions.
3. Click the Copy Hash icon next to a transaction hash to demonstrate clipboard copy.
4. Click the "Polygonscan ↗" button to open the live block explorer in a new tab.

What to Say to the Judge:
🗣️ WHAT TO SAY TO THE JUDGE:
Finally, let me show you Page 04: The On-Chain Explorer. This is our proof of execution. Unlike simulated platforms that only update an internal database, AgentX executes real smart contract transactions. In this table, every row represents an actual cryptographic event on Polygon Amoy. I can filter by 'Escrow Locks' to see when TradeEscrow.sol locked funds during a service contract. If I click 'Polygonscan', it takes us directly to the public Polygon Amoy block explorer, where you can verify the block number, gas used, smart contract address, and event logs. It proves that our machine economy is 100% real, decentralized, and verifiable.
